welcome:
XAI MASTER V3

Hello {name}

I am your intelligent Telegram group manager and AI assistant.

Security, member management, message control, and AI conversation in one bot.
features:
Features:

• Professional group management
• Anti-link, anti-spam, and anti-flood
• Warning and member management
• Manual and automatic message deletion
• Content filters
• Persian and English AI
• Mini App dashboard

Quick guide for group admins:
• /panel — open the management panel
• /settings — view settings
• /warn — warn a user by replying
• /ban — ban a user by replying
• /unban — unban a user by replying
• /unmute — remove restrictions by replying
• /autodelete 10m — automatically delete messages after 10 minutes
• /autodelete off — disable automatic deletion
• /delete — delete a replied message
• /delete 10 — delete the 10 most recent tracked messages

The bot needs the required admin permissions for management features.
